name: io.github.islobodan/cruncher-mcp
description: Scientific calculator MCP server with 43 tools: arithmetic, trig, stats, unit conversion.
title: Cruncher

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCHER_TOOL_SET
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure tier: 'minimal' (5 tools), 'standard' (34 tools, default), or 'full' (43 tools)

environmentVariables.name: CRUNCHER_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Worker thread timeout in milliseconds for heavy calculations (default: 3000, range: 100-60000)

features: worker thread isolation with timeout protection
